says: A person founds a Team alone, renames it, publishes a Team environment edition (environment.publish) and closes the Team, then recovers the closed Team's evidence through its retention authority (team.retention.apply recover_evidence, purpose preserve), which commits and returns the closed team_state. After that recovery every attempt to use the Team again is refused by its owner with team_terminal and writes nothing: a new rename (team.profile.set), a restore (team.lifecycle.apply restore), new work that continues the renamed profile's change as archived work (team.continuation.record continue_archived naming the rename's stored profile), and an adoption of the Team's published edition (environment.adopt). A recovery whose purpose is reopen has no spelling and is refused at admission. A final team.state.read at the recovery's head still returns the closed team_state and the renamed profile: no refused step returns a record, and no team_state other than closed is written.
